create_imagenet_dataset: create an ImageNet dataset instance with a specified split, root directory, and extra cache path
dump_imagenet_extra: dump ImageNet dataset entries and class metadata to numpy cache files for fast loading
get_imagenet_image_data: get raw image bytes from an ImageNet dataset sample by its index
get_imagenet_class_info: get the class ID or class name for an ImageNet sample by its index
parse_imagenet_image_path: parse an ImageNet image relative path to extract the class ID and actual index
